title.narrative: Procurement Support to the Integrated Control of Sshistosomiasis and Intestinal Helminths in Sub-Saharan Africa (ICOSA)

description.narrative: This activity Procurement Support to the Integrated Control of Sshistosomiasis and Intestinal Helminths in Sub-Saharan Africa (ICOSA) is a component of Integrated Control of Schistosomiasis and Intestinal Helminths in Sub-Saharan Africa (ICOSA) - Phase 1 & 2 reported by FCDO with a funding type of 103 - Procurement of goods and a budget of £17,924,921. This project benefits Africa, regional. It works in the following sector(s): Infectious disease control, Health policy and administrative management.
